switch.quicken_mac.step_1: In Quicken for Mac, open an account’s register, then File, Export, Register Transactions to CSV File, with All visible.
switch.quicken_mac.step_2: Do the same for each account and upload all the files together (each file is one account).
switch.quicken_windows.note: Investment accounts are left out (Montra doesn’t import buys, sells or dividends yet). Quicken writes two-digit years and your Windows date order: check the dates on the next screen.
switch.quicken_windows.step_1: In Quicken, choose File, then File Export, then QIF File.
switch.quicken_windows.step_2: Pick one account under Quicken Account to Export From, set the dates to include everything, tick Transactions, and save the file.
switch.quicken_windows.step_3: Do the same for each account, then upload all the files together (each file is one account). Transfers between them are paired.
switch.ready: Every account has its preview. Check any of them, then import them all.
switch.rocket_money.step_1: In Rocket Money, go to Transactions and choose Export (on the web) or the menu, then CSV Download (in the app).
switch.rocket_money.step_2: Pick the accounts and dates, then Export. Rocket Money emails you a download link: open it on a computer.
switch.simplifi.note: To bring split transactions over as their parts, turn on Show split transactions (the gear icon) before exporting.
switch.simplifi.step_1: Open Quicken Simplifi in a web browser (the app can’t export).
switch.simplifi.step_2: Go to Transactions. Use Filter, then Account, to tick all your accounts, and set a custom date range if you need one.
switch.simplifi.step_3: Open the three-dot menu next to Filter, choose Export to CSV, and upload the file.
switch.statements_instead: To add a bank or card statement to this workspace, use Import instead.
switch.subtitle: Move your accounts, transactions and categories into Montra in one go.
switch.tiller.step_1: Open your Tiller spreadsheet and go to the Transactions sheet.
switch.tiller.step_2: In Google Sheets choose File, Download, Comma-separated values (.csv); in Excel save the sheet as CSV. Upload that file.

switch.ynab.note: Each account’s Starting Balance becomes its opening balance, and transfers between your YNAB accounts are paired as transfers.
switch.ynab.step_1: Open YNAB in a web browser (the phone apps can’t export).
switch.ynab.step_2: Click your plan’s name at the top left, then Export Plan.
switch.ynab.step_3: YNAB downloads your plan and your transactions. Upload the transactions file (its name ends in “Register”); unzip it first if it came as a zip.
